---
title: "Topics"
# Type view: every page whose `type` is `topic`, newest first.
listing:
  id: topics
  contents:
    - "../topics/*.qmd"
    - "../topics/*.md"
    - "../dictionary/*.qmd"
    - "../dictionary/*.md"
    - "../essays/*.qmd"
    - "../essays/*.md"
    - "../prototypes/*.qmd"
    - "../prototypes/*.md"
    - "../tools/*.qmd"
    - "../tools/*.md"
  include:
    type: topic
  type: table
  sort: ["date desc", "title"]
  fields: [date, title, theme, lens, maturity]
  field-display-names:
    theme: "Theme"
    maturity: "Maturity"
    lens: "Lens"
  sort-ui: false
---
